items.question: Retained design questions need deterministic protocol defaults and bounded generated provenance integration.
items.assumption: Planning defaults for retained questions (requirements, not implementation hints): canonical complete-envelope bytes are json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8"), with no Unicode normalization. Kernel job_id must be null for every actor. Existing workflow.open is an authenticated ordinary apply with matching current binding/CAS and a receipt/revision increment; replay is receipt-only. Snapshot takes a shared lock; absent store returns ok/revision 0/result containing project_id, workflow_id:null, lease_epoch:0, owner:null and health:"absent", with no persistent creation. Existing snapshot projects workflow identity, owner, epoch, workflow reserves, actor IDs/roles, receipt count and health/capacity; excludes secrets, digests and receipt bodies, so output remains bounded at saturation. Intent read limit is 33554432 bytes and includes the canonical non-secret request so a caller can reconstruct the identical request after losing its file. Owner actor_id is fresh on each acquire. Keep revoked credential files for historical exact receipt retrieval; no secret deletion before intent cleanup. Error mapping: bad envelope/unknown operation/changed request-ID payload/oversized request or response => invalid_request; protocol/schema mismatch => incompatible_contract; stale revision => revision_conflict; actor/scope/epoch/job/project/workflow mismatch or occupied owner => wrong_binding; declared unavailable operation => missing_capability; invalid submitted evidence => rejected_evidence; corrupt state, pending unrelated intent, capacity, path/durability/I/O failure => recovery_required. Only revision_conflict is retryable. Guard Python version before importing 3.12-only modules using syntax-neutral main.py, emit fixed redacted structured incompatible_contract. Public contract reads installed bytes without symlink traversal. No real-host support is claimed. Treat source-map.json as generated metadata maintained solely through bounded snapshots/full diffs; worker context budgets count those bounded inputs, never the 13.6MB generated output. Existing source identity/history gates remain intact.
